name: Rating
description: Shows or collects a star score. Read-only, it is one image with a text alternative and supports half stars; as an input it is a group of native radios.

props.name: value
props.description: The score. Read-only, it rounds to the nearest half star. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial score of an uncontrolled input.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Shows the score instead of collecting it. Emitted as data-readonly.
props.a11y: Renders role=img with the value label instead of radios.

props.name: count
props.description: The number of reviews, shown after the value.

props.name: label
props.description: The input's accessible name, such as "Rate the viewing". Livewire defaults it to the translated "Rating".

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: The text alternative for the score and each star's radio, with :value and :max placeholders. Translated by default.

props.name: countLabel
props.description: The review count text, with a :count placeholder. Defaults to "(:count reviews)", singular for one, translated in Livewire.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { star: '…', value: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: role=radiogroup holding the stars as an input; role=img with the value label when read-only.

parts.name: item
parts.description: One star's radio and its star, as an input.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native radio for one score, visually hidden over its star. Attributes other than class land on every radio.

parts.name: star
parts.description: A star icon. data-filled when it counts, data-half when it is the half star.

parts.name: half
parts.description: The filled half of a half star, on the start side.

events.name: value-change
events.description: The score changed, as a number.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the checked star, or the first.
Raises the score by one (platform radio behavior), following the text direction.
Lowers the score by one, following the text direction.

requirements: Read-only: role=img with the value label, such as "4.2 out of 5"; the stars are decorative.
Input: native radios sharing one name, so the platform supplies roving focus and arrow keys. Each radio is labelled with the value label, such as "3 out of 5".
The stars run in the inline direction and mirror under RTL; the half star fills from the start side, and arrow keys follow the text direction.
The filled stars follow the native :checked state, so they update before a deferred wire:model round trip.
Visible focus ring on the star whose radio has :focus-visible.
Show the numeric value next to the stars; color is never the only cue.
